section.heading: Introduction
section.paragraph: Software engineering is the process of designing, developing, testing, and maintaining reliable software systems.
Modern applications require clean architecture, maintainable code, and well-defined requirements.

Developers can learn more about software engineering at
Example Website .

section.heading: Core Principles
section.paragraph: Good software engineering follows several important principles.

list-item.paragraph: Separate business logic from presentation logic.

section.heading: Development Process
section.paragraph: A typical software development process can be divided into several stages.

section.heading: Testing
section.paragraph: Testing helps identify defects before software reaches production.
Automated tests can verify that important transformations continue to work correctly after future changes.

section.heading: Application Architecture
section.paragraph: A well-designed application separates its domain model from external frameworks and presentation technologies.
In this XML authoring application, the Internal Document Model is the canonical representation of the document.

list-item.paragraph: XML is used as an input and output format.
Tiptap is used as the visual editing layer.
The Internal Document Model represents document semantics.
The XML serializer generates the final XML document.

section.heading: Conclusion
section.paragraph: Separating the document model from the editor makes the application easier to maintain and extend.
The same document model can later be used to generate XML, DOCX, and PDF documents.
